prevent-new-pollution-and-diagnose-old-p.text: The specification, tests, validator repair, Haskell readback, compiled checks, identity and documentation are complete for submission. Local checks pass. Independent audit, remote checks and merge remain pending.

dependency-order.text: Specification precedes tests, tests precede repair, and code precedes regenerated identity and verification. The frozen candidate precedes the external audit. PASS and finished remote checks precede merge. No parallel agents.
